structure: A ruling file of 23 lines: workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-11-10.md. It is laid out in the standard ruling shape: an H1 title ("Ruling: Sam, 10 November 2026"), a two-line note of the setting (Sam reviewing what in the waiting-on-design theme could be built before the session with the new interaction designer), one blockquote of six lines quoting Sam verbatim, then a "## Decided" heading with three numbered items, each a bold decision sentence followed by one to three lines of the main session's reading of it. The verbatim blockquote covers four topics in Sam's own words: germline (germinal) products not suiting the waiting-on-design theme and matching in with animals as a reference point, folding the germinals date calendar into one of the germinals rows, commodities search being handled by a different ticket and its call staying blocked until implemented, and no confirmation being needed for a transit country added to or removed from a table. The three Decided items map onto those topics: item 1 germinal products follow live animals (inc-192 leaving waiting-on-design and merging into inc-053, built with the MOJ date picker per the interaction designer's 9 November ruling), item 2 commodity search is a separate ticket (inc-014's design call on results-as-you-type stays blocked and does not go to the designer; the joined search button and the 'cattle' search listing germinal codes belong to that ticket, not this backlog), item 3 transit countries need no extra confirmation (the added-countries table already shows a country appearing or going; no visible message for an add or remove without JavaScript). The scope is "whole file", so nothing is left out: there are no tables, images, appendices or linked files to read beyond this one file. The file is far smaller than one part, so it is one part.

parts.title: The whole ruling file
parts.scope: Every line of ruling-sam-2026-11-10.md, from the H1 to the last line of Decided item 3: the title, the note of the setting, the whole verbatim blockquote and all three Decided items. Nothing in this source belongs to another part.
read: workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-11-10.md (all 23 lines, word for word: title, the setting note, the 6-line verbatim blockquote, and the three numbered items under '## Decided')
covers: The 6-line verbatim blockquote (lines 6-11), checked phrase by phrase, as the source every claim's quote comes from: germline not suiting being in the waiting-on-design thing; germlines matching in with animals as a reference point for everything; folding the Germinals date calendar into one of the rows on Germinals; that it does not suit being separate; commodities search being handled by a different ticket; the call being blocked until it's been implemented; needing nothing confirming a transit country has been added or removed when there is a row of transit countries added to a table; and the rhetorical question on what confirmation is needed other than it was there, now it isn't, or it wasn't there, now it is

Decided item 1 in full: germinal products follow live animals and are not a design question; the germinal pages take live animals as their reference for everything; the germinal dates' 'Choose date' calendar (inc-192) leaves the waiting-on-design theme; it is merged into the germinal identification dates row (inc-053); the dates are built with the MOJ date picker the other dates use, as the interaction designer ruled on 9 November - each checked against the quote, and each recorded verbatim or inferred as the quote supports (note that the quote names germlines matching animals and folding the calendar into a germinals row, but names neither inc-192, inc-053, the MOJ date picker nor the 9 November interaction designer ruling)

Decided item 2 in full: commodity search is handled by a separate ticket; the design call on results as you type (inc-014) stays blocked until that ticket has been implemented; it does not go to the designer before then; the joined search button and the 'cattle' search listing germinal codes belong to that ticket rather than to this backlog - each checked against the quote, with the inferred ones saying what in the quote implies them

Decided item 3 in full: transit countries need no extra confirmation; the added-countries table already shows a country appearing or going; no visible message is added for an add or remove without JavaScript - including whether the quote supports the 'without JavaScript' qualifier

The report questions and conflicts each item answers, named in the note of the claim that records it (such as the waiting-on-design design question on the germinal date calendar, the design question on commodity results as you type, and the design question on transit-country add/remove confirmation), with the question number and conflict id where the item names or plainly answers one

Every point the ruling touches but leaves open, as a gap claim with an empty quote: at minimum which separate ticket handles commodity search and when its design call is revisited, and whether 'does not go to the designer before then' bars only the designer session or every design route. Anything the quote only asks or floats is a gap, never a decision

The authority framing in the setting note (lines 3-4) where it bears on how far a decision reaches: that Sam decided these while reviewing what in the waiting-on-design theme could be built before the session with the new interaction designer
